thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/22/2019: LOGI, TSEM, IPGP, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/22/2019: LOGI, TSEM, IPGP, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Technology stocks were falling in Tuesday's pre-market trading .
In other sector news:
(+) Logitech International ( LOGI ) was up more than 1% after i t report ed Q3 fiscal 2019 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.79, up from $0.65 during the year-ago quarter, and beating the Capital IQ consensus forecast of $0.67.
(+) TowerJazz ( TSEM ) was more than 1% higher after saying it has teamed up with Ranix, a provider of solutions for automotive communication and IoT security, to develop RF transceivers for use in V2X, or Vehicle-to-everything, and ETCS, or Electronic Toll Collection System, modems for the automotive market.
(=) IPG Photonics ( IPGP ) was unchanged as it agreed to acquire the submarine networks division of Padtec SA, a provider of submarine networking technology and systems based in Sao Paulo. Financial terms were not disclosed.
